summary: We PULL BACK from darkness that reveals itself as the black eye of a fetus suspended in a placenta-like husk, its malleable skull growing around a brain-jack. Morpheus explains that the Machines discovered a new form of fusion needing only a small electrical charge to initiate. The husk hangs from a stalk until a thresher-like farm machine plucks it. He continues that the human body generates more bioelectricity than a 120-volt battery and over 25,000 B.T.U.'s of body heat. We RISE UP over endless fields where human beings are no longer born but grown, lightning tearing open the sky as a harvester sweeps past.

what_changes.before: He has just begun explaining the Machines' new form of fusion requiring a small electrical charge.
what_changes.after: He reveals the full horror that humans are no longer born but grown in fields as a power source.
what_changes.evidence: There are fields, endless fields where human beings are no longer born; we are grown.

what_changes.before: He states the human body generates more bioelectricity than a 120-volt battery and over 25,000 B.T.U.'s of body heat.
what_changes.after: He establishes that this bioelectricity and body heat is what the Machines harvest from grown humans.
what_changes.evidence: The human body generates more bioelectricity than a 120-volt battery and over 25,000 B.T.U.'s of body heat.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus reveals how the Machines grow humans as a power source in endless fields.
